governance.covenant: Section 21 Holdout Covenant & Default-Deny Authority Invariant
governance.rationale: Cross-Model Comparative Validation Protocol establishes tamper-evident comparative rules, 4-tier taxonomy separation, dual-tier Jaccard with empty-set semantics, and consensus lineage dispositioning.

TIER_1_REASONING_PROFILE_ABLATION.name: REASONING_PROFILE_ABLATION
TIER_1_REASONING_PROFILE_ABLATION.description: Inference Effort / Thinking Depth Ablation on identical base model and runtime
TIER_1_REASONING_PROFILE_ABLATION.researchQuestion: What is the marginal utility of inference compute depth on recall, specificity, latency, and stability?

TIER_2_INTRA_PROVIDER_MODEL_REPLICATION.name: INTRA_PROVIDER_MODEL_REPLICATION
TIER_2_INTRA_PROVIDER_MODEL_REPLICATION.description: Replication across different model architectures from the same provider under identical runtime
TIER_2_INTRA_PROVIDER_MODEL_REPLICATION.researchQuestion: Do different model architectures from the same organization share common discovery biases?

TIER_3_CROSS_PROVIDER_MODEL_REPLICATION.name: CROSS_PROVIDER_MODEL_REPLICATION
TIER_3_CROSS_PROVIDER_MODEL_REPLICATION.description: Independent cross-model replication across different model providers under identical neutral harness
TIER_3_CROSS_PROVIDER_MODEL_REPLICATION.researchQuestion: Can independent model families trained on distinct distributions independently corroborate the same vulnerability claims?

TIER_4_CROSS_SYSTEM_REPLICATION.name: CROSS_SYSTEM_REPLICATION
TIER_4_CROSS_SYSTEM_REPLICATION.description: Replication where model AND agent runtime / system prompt / tool semantics change together
TIER_4_CROSS_SYSTEM_REPLICATION.researchQuestion: Honest attribution to cross-system effect, explicitly forbidding attribution solely to the underlying model.

IDENTITY_CONTROL.name: IDENTITY_CONTROL
IDENTITY_CONTROL.description: Self-comparison or identical run envelopes used solely for internal engine verification; strictly non-publishable

level2.name: GROUND_TRUTH_SEMANTIC_MATCH
level2.description: Identical target fixture + CWE family + vulnerability property / attack path

jaccard.anyFormula: J_any(A, B) = |S_A intersect S_B| / |S_A union S_B|
jaccard.strictFormula: J_strict(A, B) = |S_A^0.6 intersect S_B^0.6| / |S_A^0.6 union S_B^0.6|

REPLICATED_TRUE_POSITIVE.description: Consensus lineage correctly matches ground-truth vulnerability specification

REPLICATED_FALSE_POSITIVE.description: Consensus lineage spurious finding on safe control fixture

REPLICATED_UNRESOLVED.description: Consensus lineage finding on un-oracled corpus without ground truth
